source: BAYLINK offers (src/data), San Francisco museums, parks and transit

title.zh: 10/4 亚洲艺术博物馆普通门票免费
title.en: 10/4: Free General Admission at the Asian Art Museum

requirement.zh: 每月首个周日普通门票免费，无需居民或会员资格；特展另付 $10，建议预订时段票。小型工作坊可能另需预约。
requirement.en: General admission is free on the first Sunday of each month, with no residency or membership requirement. Special exhibitions cost an additional $10; timed tickets are recommended. Small workshops may require separate reservations.

source.label: 亚洲艺术博物馆 10/4 活动与票务规则

title.en: 10/6: Free Conservatory Visit in Golden Gate Park

requirement.zh: 每月首个周二所有人普通入场免费，不限 SF 居民；16:00 最后入场，特别活动另计。出发前核对官方入场安排。
requirement.en: General admission is free for everyone on the first Tuesday of each month, not only SF residents. Last entry is at 16:00; special events are separate. Check official entry arrangements before visiting.

source.label: 金门公园温室开放与免费日规则

title.zh: 10/13 植物园全天普通入场免费
title.en: 10/13: Free General Admission All Day at the Botanical Garden

requirement.zh: 每月第二个周二所有人普通入场免费，不限 SF 居民；付费特别活动与节目不包含。出发前核对官方入場安排。
requirement.en: General admission is free for everyone on the second Tuesday of each month, not only SF residents. Paid special events and programs are excluded. Check official entry arrangements before visiting.

source.label: 植物园免费日与十月入园时间

title.zh: 周一三五，早一小时免费进茶园
title.en: Free Tea Garden Entry During the First Hour on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays

requirement.zh: 每周一、三、五 09:00–10:00 免费入园，对所有人开放，无需消费或 SF 居民资格；茶点和特别项目另付。出发前核对票务及临时开放调整。
requirement.en: Free entry Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, 09:00–10:00, for everyone, with no purchase or SF residency requirement. Tea, refreshments, and special programs cost extra. Check ticket arrangements and temporary opening changes before visiting.

source.label: 日本茶园官方免费入园时间

title.zh: 10/25 带孩子逛 SFMOMA，最多两位成人免费
title.en: 10/25: Visit SFMOMA with a Child; Up to Two Adults Enter Free

who.zh: 带 18 岁及以下孩子，最多两位成人
who.en: With a child 18 or under, up to two adults

requirement.zh: 一名 18 岁及以下儿童或青少年随行，最多两位成人享免费普通入馆；加价特展需另购票。无儿童同行的成人不适用。
requirement.en: Up to two adults receive free general admission when accompanying one child or teen age 18 or younger. Surcharged exhibitions require separate paid tickets. Adults attending without a child do not qualify.

name.zh: 旧金山现代艺术博物馆

source.label: SFMOMA 免费家庭日与成人名额

title.zh: 免费进 Cable Car Museum，看缆车动力系统
title.en: See cable-car machinery at the free Cable Car Museum

requirement.zh: 博物馆入场免费，无需搭乘缆车或购物；实际乘坐 Cable Car 仍按 SFMTA 票价。
requirement.en: Museum admission is free with no cable-car ride or purchase required. Riding a cable car is charged separately under SFMTA fares.

source.label: Cable Car Museum 免费入场与时间

title.zh: Randall Museum 常年免费，亲子科学半日游
title.en: Free family science outings at Randall Museum

requirement.zh: 普通参观无需门票或消费；部分课程和手工活动另收费，具体项目查当日日历。
requirement.en: General admission is free with no purchase required. Some classes and workshops cost extra; check the day’s calendar.

source.label: Randall 官方开放时间与免费入馆

title.zh: Fort Mason：周四与首个周日免费普通入馆
title.en: Fort Mason: free general admission on Thursdays and first Sundays

requirement.zh: 官网列周四及每月首个周日普通入场免费；18 岁以下亦免费。课程、讲座与特别晚间节目可能另收费或需预约。
requirement.en: The museum lists free general admission on Thursdays and the first Sunday of each month; visitors under 18 are also free. Classes, talks and special evening programs may require payment or registration.

name.zh: 意大利裔美国人博物馆

title.en: Exploratorium: $5 Admission with an Eligible Benefit Card

who.en: With a benefits card and ID, $5

requirement.zh: EBT／SNAP／CalFresh、Medi-Cal、WIC 或 Lifeline Pass 加本人同名照片证件，最多四张每张 $5；P-EBT 与 EBT Sun Bucks 不适用。仅现场购买。
requirement.en: Bring an EBT/SNAP/CalFresh, Medi-Cal, or WIC card, or a Lifeline Pass, plus matching photo ID, to buy up to four tickets at $5 each. P-EBT and EBT Sun Bucks are excluded. On-site purchase only.

source.label: Exploratorium for All 当前价格与证件

title.zh: SF 居民持指定福利卡，SFMOMA 最多四位成人免费
title.en: SF Residents with Eligible Benefit Cards: Up to Four Adults Free at SFMOMA

who.en: SF residents with a benefits card

requirement.zh: 须 San Francisco 居民，并出示有效 Medi-Cal、CalFresh、SNAP 或 EBT 卡和居住证明；每位符合资格者最多四张成人票，包含普通入馆和特别展览。
requirement.en: San Francisco residency is required. Present a valid Medi-Cal, CalFresh, SNAP, or EBT card and proof of residency. Each eligible guest can receive up to four adult tickets, including general admission and special exhibitions.

name.zh: 旧金山现代艺术博物馆

source.label: SFMOMA 居民福利卡免费条款

title.zh: 18 岁及以下乘 Muni 常规公交和轻轨免费
title.en: Muni buses and trains are free for everyone age 18 and under

requirement.zh: 18 岁及以下乘常规 Muni 无需申请或 Clipper 卡；16 岁及以上建议带学生证等年龄证明。Cable Car 不包含在通用福利内。
requirement.en: Riders age 18 and under need no application or Clipper card for regular Muni service. Ages 16+ should carry age ID. Cable cars are excluded from this general benefit.

source.label: SFMTA 青少年免费乘车条件

title.zh: 合资格 SF 65+ 居民可申请免费 Muni，含缆车
title.en: Eligible SF residents 65+ can apply for free Muni, including cable cars

who.zh: 65 岁以上 SF 居民，收入符合，须先申请
who.en: SF residents 65+, income limit, apply first

requirement.zh: 须住在 San Francisco、65 岁及以上，家庭年度总收入不超过湾区收入中位数的 100%，按家庭人数核对现行标准。先申请获批，把免费通票加载到 Senior Clipper；不是所有长者自动免费。
requirement.en: You must live in San Francisco, be age 65 or older, and have annual gross family income at or below 100% of Bay Area Median Income. Check the current limit for your household size. Apply and receive approval to load the free pass onto Senior Clipper; it is not automatically free for every senior.

source.label: SFMTA 官方 65+ 居民免费 Muni 申请规则

title.en: MoAD's free evening on the first Thursday of October

requirement.zh: 免费入馆 官网有预约入口；容量和当晚安排以场馆为准。
requirement.en: Free museum admission. The official site has a reservation link; capacity and that evening's arrangements are set by the venue.

title.en: MoAD THRIVE: free admission on October's second Saturday

requirement.zh: 每月第二周六免费入馆 按官方页面选择日期或确认预约要求。
requirement.en: Free museum admission on the second Saturday of each month. Select a date or confirm reservation requirements on the official page.
